about: The Mac App Store listing for Ouro MD, staged by spoonjoy/spoonjoy-apple's stager (scripts/stage-app-store-listing.rb --platform MAC_OS) with the frames Store scenes renders. versionString is the version submitted with the next build. Price, availability, age rating, categories and content rights are left out on purpose: they are set in App Store Connect and never changed by staging.

review.notes:
Version 0.9.81 was rejected under 4.3(a), and the App Review Board upheld that in September. This build, 0.9.113, has 51 changes since then. The ones that add functionality 0.9.81 did not have:

1. Change marks for edits made outside the app. When another program rewrites the open file (a coding agent, a script, another editor), Ouro MD reloads it without moving your place and draws a bar in the left margin beside each changed passage, with a mark where text was deleted. A mark clears once you have read past it, and a "Next change" button jumps to marks that are off screen.
2. Siri and Shortcuts actions: Open, Get, Add to and Replace Markdown Document. They work on the documents open in Ouro MD and the ones opened recently, inside the sandbox.
3. Print and Export PDF share one page layout, with a live page preview, margins, link footnotes and page breaks before chosen headings.
4. The macOS 27 system design in the toolbar and document controls, and Apple's Writing Tools in the editor.

What has not changed: Markdown renders in the same view you type in, with no separate preview pane, on your own local files. There is no account. The app is free, with no ads and no in-app purchases.

To see the change marks (about a minute):
1. In Terminal, run: printf '# Plan\n\nFirst draft.\n' > ~/Desktop/plan.md
2. Open plan.md in Ouro MD with File > Open and leave the window open.
3. In Terminal, run: printf '\nA paragraph added by another program.\n' >> ~/Desktop/plan.md
4. The new paragraph appears in place with a bar beside it in the left margin. The scroll position does not change.

To try the Shortcuts actions: open the Shortcuts app, search for Ouro MD, and run Get Markdown Document on plan.md.

Everything else: No account or sign-in is needed. Shift-Command-O opens a folder, with the File Tree, Outline and Search in the sidebar. Shift-Command-P opens the Command Palette. File > Export saves PDF or HTML. The App Store build has the direct-download updater turned off and telemetry disabled.

en-US.name: Ouro MD
en-US.subtitle: Local Markdown Workspace
en-US.description:
Ouro MD is a quiet Markdown editor for your Mac, made for reading and revising what you and your agents write.

READ IT LIKE A PAGE
Type Markdown and it renders right where you type, on a centered page with careful typography. Headings, tables, task lists, code, math, footnotes and diagrams render in place, and the syntax markers stay faint so the words come first. Prefer the raw text? Source mode, WYSIWYG and Split are a keystroke away.

SEE WHAT CHANGED
Leave a note in the file, let your agent revise it, and keep reading. When the file changes on disk, Ouro MD marks the passages that changed and keeps your place on the page, so you check the new words instead of rereading the old ones.

YOUR FILES, YOUR FOLDERS
Ouro MD opens the Markdown files you already keep in Finder. Open a folder to browse it in the File Tree, follow a long document in the Outline, and search every file in the folder. No account and no hosted notes: your files stay where you put them.

FOUR WAYS TO READ
Quartz for calm daylight, Graphite for late nights, Manuscript in warm serif and Newsprint in crisp editorial type. Switch live, or add your own CSS.

MADE FOR THE KEYBOARD
The command palette (Shift-Command-P) reaches export, themes, modes, headings, tables and more. Focus mode dims everything but the paragraph you're in, and Typewriter mode keeps your line in the middle of the window.

SHARE IT FINISHED
Export themed, self-contained HTML or PDF, or print with page margins, link footnotes and page breaks before chosen headings. Printing and exporting never change your Markdown.

Ouro MD is free, with no ads and no in-app purchases.
en-US.promotionalText: Read what your agents write. Markdown renders where you type, changed passages are marked when the file changes on disk, and your files stay in your folders.
